content.text:
Resource Types and Filter Fields:
  kafka: A Kafka cluster
    resource.kafka.id — ID of the Kafka cluster
    resource.kafka.name — Name of the Kafka cluster
  connector: A Kafka Connector
    resource.connector.id — ID of the connector
    resource.connector.name — Name of the connector
  ksql: A ksqlDB application
    resource.ksql.id — ID of the ksqlDB application
    resource.ksql.name — Name of the ksqlDB application
  schema_registry: A schema registry
    resource.schema_registry.id — ID of the schema registry
    resource.schema_registry.name — Name of the schema registry
  compute_pool: A Flink compute pool
    resource.compute_pool.id — ID of the Flink compute pool
    resource.compute_pool.name — Name of the Flink compute pool
  flink_materialized_table: A Flink materialized table
    resource.flink_materialized_table.name — Name of the Flink materialized table
    resource.flink_materialized_table.uid — UID of the Flink materialized table
    resource.flink_materialized_table.version — Version of the Flink materialized table
  flink_statement: A Flink statement
    resource.flink_statement.uid — UID of the Flink statement
    resource.flink_statement.name — Name of the Flink statement

Available Metrics: 112

io.confluent.kafka.server/received_bytes
  Total bytes received by the cluster from producers
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.topic, metric.partition

io.confluent.kafka.server/sent_bytes
  Total bytes sent by the cluster to consumers
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.topic, metric.partition

io.confluent.kafka.server/received_records
  Total records received by the cluster from producers
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.topic

io.confluent.kafka.server/sent_records
  Total records sent by the cluster to consumers
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.topic

io.confluent.kafka.server/retained_bytes
  Total bytes retained (stored) by the cluster
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.topic, metric.partition

io.confluent.kafka.server/consumer_lag_offsets
  Consumer lag in number of offsets for a consumer group
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.topic, metric.consumer_group_id, metric.partition

io.confluent.kafka.server/request_count
  Total number of requests to the cluster
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.type

io.confluent.kafka.server/request_bytes
  Total request bytes sent to the cluster
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.type

io.confluent.kafka.server/response_bytes
  Total response bytes received from the cluster
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: kafka
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.type

io.confluent.kafka.server/active_connection_count
  Number of active authenticated connections to the cluster
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka

io.confluent.kafka.server/partition_count
  Number of partitions in the cluster
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka

io.confluent.kafka.server/successful_authentication_count
  Number of successful authentications
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: kafka

io.confluent.flink/compute_pool_utilization/cfu_limit
  The possible max number of CFUs for the pool
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool

io.confluent.flink/compute_pool_utilization/cfu_minutes_consumed
  The number of how many CFUs consumed since the last measurement
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool

io.confluent.flink/compute_pool_utilization/current_cfus
  The absolute number of CFUs at a given moment
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool

io.confluent.flink/current_input_watermark_milliseconds
  The last watermark this statement has received (in milliseconds) for the given table.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/current_output_watermark_milliseconds
  The last watermark this statement has produced (in milliseconds) to the given table.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/external_table_egress_bytes
  Bytes sent from Flink compute pool to external table connection.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.external_table_provider, metric.external_table_function

io.confluent.flink/external_table_ingress_bytes
  Bytes received from external table connection.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: By | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.external_table_provider, metric.external_table_function

io.confluent.flink/materialized_table_status
  This metric monitors the status of a materialized table within the system. Its value is always set to 1, signifying the materialized table's presence. The materialized table's current operational state is identified through the metric.status tag.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.status

io.confluent.flink/materialized_table_utilization/cfu_minutes_consumed
  The number of how many CFUs consumed since the last measurement
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table

io.confluent.flink/materialized_table_utilization/current_cfus
  The absolute number of CFUs at a given moment
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table

io.confluent.flink/max_input_lateness_milliseconds
  The maximum observed lateness across all records processed in the last minute. A record is considered late if it has a timestamp less than or equal to the current watermark.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/num_late_records_in
  Total number of input records classified as late events. These are records whose timestamp is less than or equal to the current watermark.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/num_records_in
  Total number of records this statement has received.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/num_records_in_errors
  Total number of input records that failed deserialization on the source. With error-handling.mode=LOG these records are routed to the error-log target table; with IGNORE mode they are discarded; with FAIL mode the statement fails.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/num_records_in_from_files
  Total number of records this statement has read from Tableflow files.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/num_records_in_from_topics
  Total number of records this statement has read from Kafka topics.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/num_records_out
  Total number of records this task statement emitted.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/operator/current_input_watermark_ms
  Current input watermark of the flink operator
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/current_output_watermark_ms
  Current output watermark of the flink operator
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/current_parallelism
  The current parallelism of this operator
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/max_input_lateness_milliseconds
  The maximum observed lateness across all records processed in the last minute. A record is considered late if it has a timestamp less than or equal to the current watermark.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/max_parallelism
  The max parallelism of this operator
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/num_bytes_in
  Count of bytes this operator has received.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/num_bytes_out
  Count of bytes this operator has emitted.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/num_late_records_dropped
  Total number of input records this operator dropped because they arrived late, after the watermark had already passed the record timestamp.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/num_late_records_in
  Total number of input records classified as late events. These are records whose timestamp is less than or equal to the current watermark.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/num_records_in
  Count of records this operator has received.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/num_records_out
  Count of records this operator has emitted.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/operator/state_size_bytes
  The size in bytes of this operator state
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/pending_records
  Total amount of available records after the consumer offset in a Kafka partition across all operators
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.table_name, metric.table_name_v2

io.confluent.flink/split/current_watermark_ms
  Current watermark of the flink split
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/split/watermark_active_time_ms_per_second
  Accumulated time (in milliseconds) this split was neither idle due to idleness settings nor paused due to watermark alignment
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/split/watermark_idle_time_ms_per_second
  Accumulated time (in milliseconds) this split was marked idle by idleness detection
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/split/watermark_paused_time_ms_per_second
  Accumulated time (in milliseconds) this split was paused due to watermark alignment
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/statement_status
  This metric monitors the status of a statement within the system. Its value is always set to 1, signifying the statement's presence. The statement's current operational state is identified through the metric.status tag.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_statement
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.status

io.confluent.flink/statement_utilization/cfu_minutes_consumed
  The number of how many CFUs consumed since the last measurement
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/statement_utilization/current_cfus
  The absolute number of CFUs at a given moment
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/backpressure_time_ms_per_second
  The amount of milliseconds this task has spent being backpressured
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/busy_time_ms_per_second
  The amount of milliseconds this task has spent being busy
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/idle_time_ms_per_second
  The amount of milliseconds this task has spent being idle
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/max_input_lateness_milliseconds
  The maximum observed lateness across all records processed in the last minute. A record is considered late if it has a timestamp less than or equal to the current watermark.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/num_bytes_in
  Count of bytes this task has received.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/num_bytes_out
  Count of bytes this task has emitted.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/num_late_records_in
  Total number of input records classified as late events. These are records whose timestamp is less than or equal to the current watermark.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/num_records_in
  Count of records this task has received.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.flink/task/num_records_out
  Count of records this task has emitted.
  Type: COUNTER_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: compute_pool, flink_materialized_table, flink_statement

io.confluent.kafka.connect/billable_bytes
  The delta count of billable bytes for the sink connector. Depending on the connector's billing mechanism, bytes are counted either as decompressed record bytes or as compressed bytes read from Kafka. Each sample is the number of billable bytes since the previous data point. The count is sampled every 60 seconds.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: By | Resources: connector
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.connector_target_region

io.confluent.kafka.connect/connector_status
  This metric monitors the status of a connector within the system. Its value is always set to 1, signifying the connector's presence. The connector's current operational state is identified through the metric.status tag.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.status, metric.plugin_type

io.confluent.kafka.connect/connector_task_batch_size_avg
  Monitors the average batch size (measured by record count) per minute. For a source connector, it indicates the average batch size sent to Kafka. For a sink connector, it indicates the average batch size read by the sink task.
  Type: GAUGE_DOUBLE | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.task

io.confluent.kafka.connect/connector_task_batch_size_max
  Monitors the maximum batch size (measured by record count) per minute. For a source connector, it indicates the max batch size sent to Kafka. For a sink connector, it indicates the max batch size read by the sink task.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.task

io.confluent.kafka.connect/connector_task_status
  This metric monitors the status of a connector's task within the system. Its value is always set to 1, signifying the connector task's presence. The connector's current operational state is identified through the metric.status tag.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.status, metric.task, metric.plugin_type

io.confluent.kafka.connect/dead_letter_queue_records
  The delta count of dead letter queue records written to Kafka for the sink connector. The count is sampled every 60 seconds.
  Type: COUNTER_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/dynamodb_cdc_source_connector_lag_milliseconds
  It is applicable only for DynamoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of milliseconds between the last change event’s timestamp and the connector processing it. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: connector
  Filter/group_by labels: metric.task, metric.shard_id

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_aborted
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents whether the Snapshot is aborted. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_milliseconds_since_last_event
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of milliseconds since the last snapshot event was recorded. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_paused_duration_in_seconds
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the total paused duration of the snapshot in seconds. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_total_number_of_events_seen
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the total number of events that this connector has seen since last started or reset. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_committed_transactions
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of processed transactions that were committed. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_disconnects
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of disconnects by the connector. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_large_transactions
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of transactions that have not fit into the look-ahead buffer. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_rolled_back_transactions
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of processed transactions that were rolled back and not streamed. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_skipped_events
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of events that have been skipped by the connector. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mariadb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_total_number_of_events_seen
  It is applicable only for MARIADB CDC source V2 connector. It represents the total number of data change events reported by the source database since the last connector start, or since a metrics reset. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_lag_milliseconds
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of milliseconds between the last change event's timestamp and the connector processing it. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_aborted
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents whether the Snapshot is aborted. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_completed
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents whether the Snapshot is completed. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_duration_in_seconds
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the total number of seconds that the snapshot has taken so far, even if not complete.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_milliseconds_since_last_event
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of milliseconds since the last snapshot event was recorded. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_number_of_disconnects
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of disconnects by the connector during snapshot.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_paused_duration_in_seconds
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the total paused duration of the snapshot in seconds. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_running
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents whether the Snapshot is running. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_snapshot_total_number_of_events_seen
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the total number of events that this connector has seen since last started or reset. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_is_connected
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents whether the connector is currently connected to the database server.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_milliseconds_since_last_event
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of milliseconds since the last streaming event was recorded. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_committed_transactions
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of processed transactions that were committed.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_disconnects
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of disconnects by the connector.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_events_filtered
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of events that have been filtered by include/exclude list filtering rules configured on the connector. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_number_of_primary_elections
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the number of primary elections observed by the connector. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mongodb_cdc_source_connector_streaming_total_number_of_events_seen
  It is applicable only for MongoDB CDC source connector. It represents the total number of data change events reported by the source database since the last connector start, or since a metrics reset. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: 1 | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mysql_cdc_source_connector_lag_milliseconds
  It is applicable only for MySQL CDC source V2 connector. It represents the number of milliseconds between the last change event’s timestamp and the connector processing it. The values will incorporate any differences between the clocks on the machines where the database server and the connector are running.
  Type: GAUGE_INT64 | Unit: ms | Resources: connector

io.confluent.kafka.connect/mysql_cdc_source_connector_schema_history_status
